notes: Authenticated Assistant-Developer review jobs with persistent retries, task status, queue controls and audited policy profiles; a compatible independent Developer app is required.
Queued public source inspection with recovery, partial reports and measured stages. Inspection does not approve or perform source changes, builds or installation.
Weather location recovers promptly when permission is revoked or providers return no fix.
Activity-aware speech-capture watchdogs and manual finish/cancel controls.
Live-conversation recovery after recoverable recognition failures and reply timeouts.
Wake readiness reported from the engine rather than the enabled setting.
Installed version and current permission/capability reporting without an AI connection.
Calendar-day forecast selection and weather follow-up corrections.
Capture-boundary timing survives long speech; recognition and speech-output failures are distinguished without retaining audio or transcripts.
Existing screen supervision, local device commands, personal model controls and Self Diagnostics report review.
Actionable AI failures stay attributed to each attempted provider; gateway errors remain sanitized and cannot supply learned actions.
